title: scGR-seq: Integrated analysis of glycan and RNA in single cells
protocol: Recoat each well of a 6-well plate with 1 mL of Matrigel.
Allow the Matrigel to sit at room temperature for 1 hour.
Thaw mTeSR Plus media at 37°C for 5-15 minutes.
Plate an appropriate number of 201B7 hiPSCs in a 6-well plate containing 2 mL of thawed mTeSR Plus media.
Culture the cells for 2-3 days in a CO2 incubator set to 5% CO2.
Recover the cells using gentle cell dissociation reagent and resuspend them in mFreSR Cryopreservation Medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Pause point: HiPSCs are suspended in mFreSR Cryopreservation Medium and stored in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw STEMdiff™ Neural Induction Medium at room temperature (15°C–25°C) or overnight (2°C–8°C).
Swirl the medium thoroughly before use.
Thaw STEMdiff™ SMADi Neural Induction Supplement under the same conditions as the medium.
Mix 0.5 mL of the supplement with 250 mL of the neural induction medium thoroughly.
Warm the mixture to room temperature before use.
Recoat each well of a 6-well plate with 1 mL of Matrigel and allow it to sit at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash hiPSCs cultured in wells with 2 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Add 1 mL of gentle cell dissociation reagent to the washed cells.
Incubate the cells with the reagent at 37°C for 8-10 minutes.
Pipet up and down 3–5 times to dissociate the cell aggregates.
Collect the cells in a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash the plate with 2 mL PBS and collect the remaining cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Count the viable cells with a hemocytometer using Trypan blue dye method.
Centrifuge the 15 mL conical tube at 300×g for 4 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellets with NIM supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632 to achieve a final concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add 2 mL cell suspension (2 × 10^6 cells/well) into a single well of Matrigel-coated plate.
Incubate the cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 11 days.
Change the medium every other day using fresh NIM without Y-27632.
Aspirate the media from the plates.
Add 1 mL of Accutase per well and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 min.
Collect the cell suspension in a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash the plates with 2 mL pre-warmed DMEM/F12 media, and collect the residual in the same tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300×g for 4 min.
Resuspend the resulting cell pellet in NIM.
Use the resuspended cells for evaluation of differentiation state by qRT-PCR and fluorescence staining of hiPSC markers (POU5F1) and NPC markers (SOX1, NESTIN, PAX6, FOXG1).
Suspend hiPSC-derived NPCs in mFreSR Cryopreservation Medium.
Store the suspended cells in liquid nitrogen.
Perform all experiments inside a biosafety cabinet in the dark.
Wear personal protective equipment including gloves and goggles.
Take 1 × 10^5 cells in a 1.5 mL microtube.
Centrifuge at 600×g for 4 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of PBS/BSA.
Repeat the washing step twice.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend in 90 μL of PBS/BSA/CaCl2 containing 10 μL of DNA-barcoded lectin mix (5 μg/mL of each lectin, 10 μL).
Incubate cells on ice for 1 h in the dark.
Centrifuge at 600×g for 4 min at 4°C after incubation.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of PBS/BSA/CaCl2.
Repeat the washing step three times.
Add 200 μL of PBS/BSA/CaCl2 and count the cell number.
Dispense single cells into the cap of Optical Flat 8-Cap Strips (for 0.2 mL tubes) by manually picking them using TOPick I Live Cell Pick system or other methods.
Cover the tubes with the cap containing single cells, spin down, and keep them on ice.
Expose cells to UV light for 15 min using UVP Blak-Ray XX-15L UV Bench Lamp.
Centrifuge at 3,549×g for 30 s at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant into new 0.2 mL 8-tube strips and keep on ice.
Add 2.5 μL of cell lysis buffer to each tube.
Cover the tubes with a cap.
Spin down and store at −80°C for single-cell RNA-seq.
Prepare PCR mix by combining 9.75 μL supernatant, 12.5 μL NEBNext UltraII Q5 Master Mix, 0.25 μL i5 index primer (100 mM), and 2.5 μL i7 index primer (10 mM).
Perform PCR reactions as specified.
Combine 16 samples into a 1.5 mL microtube.
Add 320 μL of AMPure to the tube and gently pipette contents 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 5 min.
Place tubes on magnetic stand for 2 min.
Discard supernatants without disturbing magnetic beads.
Add 1 mL of 80% ethanol into microtube.
Incubate at RT for 30 s on magnetic stand.
Discard supernatant and repeat washing step three times.
Air-dry magnetic beads at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Remove microtube from magnetic stand and add 160 μL of 10 mM Tris (pH 8.5).
Gently pipette the contents ten times.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Expose tube to magnetic stand and carefully collect supernatant to a 15 mL tube.
Add five volumes of DNA Binding Buffer to the 15 mL tube and mix briefly by vortexing.
Transfer mixture into a Collection Tube containing Zymo-Spin Column.
Centrifuge for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.
Add 200 μL of DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds.
Repeat washing step.
Add 20 μL DNA Elution Buffer directly to the column matrix.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Transfer column to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 20,400×g for 30 seconds at 4°C.
Use 6.5 μL of elution fraction to analyze size and quantity of PCR products using the MultiNA with DNA-500 kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Denature library DNA if concentration is greater than 4 nM.
Dilute the concentration of library DNA to 4 nM with nuclease-free water.
Mix equal amounts of the diluted library DNA mixture.
Mix 4 μL of the library DNA mixture with 4 μL of 0.1 N NaOH, briefly by vortexing and spin down.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes and keep on ice.
Add 4 μL of 2 nM library DNA to 796 μL of pre-chilled HT1 for a total volume of 800 μL (10 pM library DNA).
Mix briefly by vortexing and spin down.
Denature PhiXMix: Mix 1 μL of 10 nM PhiX, 4 μL of nuclease-free water, and 5 μL of 0.1 N NaOH for a total volume of 10 μL (1 nM of Phix).
Mix briefly by vortexing and spin down.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes and chill on ice.
Mix 2 μL of 1 nM denatured PhiX with 248 μL of pre-chilled HT1 for a total volume of 250 μL (8 pM PhiX).
Mix briefly by vortexing and spin down.
Mix 540 μL of library DNA with 130 μL of 8 pM PhiX.
Heat at 96°C for 2 minutes and chill on ice immediately followed by incubation for 5 minutes.
Load 600 μL of the library mix into the reagent cartridge of MiSeq Reagent kit.
Perform all single cell RNA-seq experiments inside a biosafety cabinet in the dark.
Wear gloves, masks, and goggles during experiments to prevent contamination.
Wipe all instruments used for the experiment with RNase remover (RnaseAway).
Handle all reagents carefully to avoid contamination with RNase.
Prepare and dispense all reagents on ice to inactivate RNase and maintain enzyme activity.
Prepare cDNA library using full-length total RNA-sequencing method (RamDA-seq) from single cells, following manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify the library DNA from individual samples derived from single cells using microchip electrophoresis system (MultiNA with DNA-12000 kit).
Check for a band of 150–600 bp to confirm successful construction of DNA library.
Pool and mix each library DNA and transfer 50–100 fmol into a 1.5 mL tube.
Sequence the mixed library DNA using a next-generation sequencer such as Novaseq6000, according to the guidelines provided by the manufacturer.
